import json, yaml

registry = yaml.safe_load(data['result'])
experiments = registry['data']['experiments']

for exp_id, exp in experiments.items():
    status_counts[exp.get('status', 'UNKNOWN')] += 1

print('=== EXPERIMENT COUNTS BY STATUS ===')
for status, count in status_counts.most_common():
    print(f'  {status}: {count}')

        print(f'    data_path: {spec.get(\"data_path\", \"N/A\")}')
        print(f'    seed: {spec.get(\"seed\", \"N/A\")}')
        # Show all other spec fields
        other_fields = {k:v for k,v in spec.items() if k not in ['hypothesis','server','gpu','pid','command','model_name','data_path','seed']}
        if other_fields:
            print(f'    other_spec: {other_fields}')

print()
print('=== PREPARING EXPERIMENTS ===')
for exp_id, exp in experiments.items():

        print(f'\\n  exp_id: {exp_id}')
